items.title: Air-cooled chiller
items.text: Cooling is provided by a central air-cooled chiller system. Equipment appeared to be operating as intended based on available site observations.

items.title: Cooling distribution observations
items.text: Chilled water is distributed to major cooling loads throughout the building. Piping, valves, and pumps were observed in generally serviceable condition during the walkthrough.

items.title: Cooling controls
items.text: Cooling system control is handled through BAS schedules and setpoints. Sequence verification and trend analysis are recommended for additional optimization opportunities.
